openQuestions: Syllabus wording was reproduced from memory of the UPSC CSE History optional syllabus; check every unit and node title against the current UPSC notification, including its Hindi version.
Paper 2 topics 8 and 9 have no heading in UPSC's text; short unit labels were added ('Birth of Indian Nationalism and the Early Congress', 'Gandhi and Mass Nationalism').
Paper 2 unit 10 (constitutional developments 1858-1935) was split into two nodes by period, naming the main Acts; UPSC gives it as one line.

Sources split into two nodes (archaeological; literary and foreign) as the brief allowed; prehistory split into Palaeolithic-Mesolithic and Neolithic-Chalcolithic; Indus into origin-extent-characteristics and decline-art.

Contested matters (Indus script, Harappan origins, Indus-Sarasvati naming, Lothal dockyard, early rice and domestication dates, Daimabad hoard) are presented as debated with the main positions; the Hindi editor may want to check the neutral phrasing.
Thinkers fields list archaeologists and historians (Cunningham, Prinsep, Kosambi, Sankalia, Childe, Marshall, Wheeler, Mahadevan); the owner may prefer thinkers to be empty for early-history nodes.
Several example sources cite Upinder Singh (2008) generally, without page or chapter; editors may want chapter references.
